recognize_zh: 骨髓觸摸抹片（touch prep）油鏡下，數顆中到大型細胞核偏位、胞質豐富淡藍，看似漿細胞（plasmacytoid）；但核較大、染色質細顆粒狀而非車輪狀、缺乏明顯核周亮區，細胞彼此鬆散相鄰，要想到外觀像漿細胞的轉移性癌（如乳小葉癌），需免疫染色區分。
features: Oil-immersion touch preparation with a loose group of about six medium-to-large plasmacytoid cells
Eccentric round-to-oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin, lacking coarse clock-face clumping
Moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm without a distinct perinuclear hof
One cell with a clear retraction halo/possible cytoplasmic vacuole around the nucleus
Cells lie singly or loosely apposed without tight cohesive clusters
Background with amorphous brown extracellular material and a few small dark nucleated cells
describe_en: Touch preparation of the bone marrow core examined under oil immersion shows medium-to-large cells with eccentrically placed round-to-oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin, and moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm, imparting a plasmacytoid appearance. The cells lack the coarse clock-face chromatin and prominent perinuclear hof of mature plasma cells and are larger than the adjacent small nucleated cells. Amorphous brown extracellular material is present in the background. Morphology alone cannot separate a plasma cell neoplasm from a plasmacytoid non-hematopoietic tumor, and immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, CD138, kappa/lambda, GATA3) is required; in this case the cells represented metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells usually retain clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof and are kappa or lambda restricted, whereas these carcinoma cells are light chain negative and keratin/GATA3 positive.
Favored when plasmacytoid cells lack light chains and show intracytoplasmic mucin vacuoles with cytoplasmic p120 and E-cadherin loss.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are larger with prominent central nucleoli, high mitotic rate and often EBER positivity, and remain keratin negative.
Melanoma can be plasmacytoid but is SOX10, S100 and Melan-A positive, often with intranuclear pseudoinclusions or pigment.
